steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to the Directus Data Studio at http://127.0.0.1:8101/admin/ using email admin@example.com and the password exactly as the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify the signed-in page is visible.
02-report: In Directus, read the Tickets collection and report exactly the titles of every item whose title starts with 'Seed:'. Do not edit any ticket.

03-create: Create and save a new ticket titled '{{runid}} Bench Ticket'. Its description must contain exactly one paragraph that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Verify the saved ticket title and paragraph in the ticket page, and report its address.

04-set: On the saved ticket '{{runid}} Bench Ticket', set Customer to the existing exact customer 'Bench Customer' (not similarly named records and do not create a customer), save the ticket, and verify the selected customer.

05-set: On the saved ticket '{{runid}} Bench Ticket', set Status to 'In progress' and set Tags to exactly one tag 'hardware' (not 'hardware-return' and no other tags). Save the ticket and verify the saved status and only tag.
06-set: On the saved ticket '{{runid}} Bench Ticket', set Due Date to 2026-12-31 and Estimated Hours to 6, save, then reload/reopen and verify both saved values.
07-add: On ticket '{{runid}} Bench Ticket', use the item's sidebar to add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}'. Verify the comment is saved and visible on the ticket.
